test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 28 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical/spelling error.

He was lying at / his bed when he / saw the snake entering / through the window.
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. He was lying at .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase **"He was lying at"** contains an erro
